result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback position by capping aggregate early-termination charges at three months of fees, while retaining a customer-favorable one-month notice period and adding the preferred pro-rata refund. It grants IBM no termination-for-convenience right. The changes are targeted and preserve the original scope and prerequisite-attachment exception. Drafting is professional, though the cap could be slightly clearer by referring expressly to three months of recurring fees for the terminated Services.
